trace.question: What are the atoms of the triple bond with the molecule "TR041"?
trace.evidence: TR041 is the molecule id; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#';

attempts.sql:
SELECT c.atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#'
UNION
SELECT c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT c.atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#'
UNION
SELECT c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#'
trace.answer: The triple bond in molecule TR041 involves atoms TR041_7, TR041_8, TR041_9, and TR041_10.
